_comment: Power Apps canvas app configuration for Plant Delivery & Office Inventory Management. Update environment_url before deploying.

app_metadata.name: Plant Delivery & Office Inventory Management
app_metadata.description: Canvas app for submitting plant delivery orders and monitoring warehouse inventory across offices.

screens.name: scrHome
screens.purpose: Landing screen. Shows navigation buttons based on the current user's role.

screens.name: scrSubmitOrder
screens.purpose: Allows Office Managers and Admins to browse available plants, add quantities, and submit a delivery order.

controls.name: txtQtyInput
controls.purpose: Per-row quantity input inside the gallery

screens.name: scrMyOrders
screens.purpose: Shows the current user's orders with status badges and drill-down to order items.

controls.name: rectStatusBadge
controls.fill_formula: Switch(ThisItem.Status, 'Status (Orders)'.Pending, RGBA(255,193,7,1), 'Status (Orders)'.Confirmed, RGBA(13,110,253,1), 'Status (Orders)'.'In Transit', RGBA(253,126,20,1), 'Status (Orders)'.Delivered, RGBA(25,135,84,1), RGBA(108,117,125,1))

screens.name: scrInventoryDashboard
screens.purpose: Displays all inventory items with low-stock highlighting. Warehouse users can update quantities inline.

controls.name: galInventoryDashboard
controls.row_fill_formula: If(ThisItem.'Quantity In Stock' < ThisItem.'Reorder Threshold', RGBA(255,235,235,1), RGBA(255,255,255,1))

controls.name: btnSaveQty
controls.label: Save
controls.on_select_formula: Patch(Inventory, ThisItem, {'Quantity In Stock': Value(txtQtyEdit.Text), 'Last Updated': Now()})

key_formulas._comment: Reference formulas. Copy these into Power Apps Studio properties.
key_formulas.app_on_start: Set(varUserRole, LookUp(/* RoleTable */, UserEmail = User().Email, Role)); Set(varUserOffice, LookUp(Offices, /* match user */)); ClearCollect(colOrderItems, [])
key_formulas.submit_order_patch: Set(varNewOrder, Patch(Orders, Defaults(Orders), {'Requested By': LookUp(Users, 'Primary Email' = User().Email), 'Order Date': Now(), Status: 'Status (Orders)'.Pending, Office: varUserOffice, Notes: txtNotes.Text})); ForAll(colOrderItems, Patch('Order Items', Defaults('Order Items'), {Order: varNewOrder, Plant: ThisRecord.Plant, 'Quantity Requested': ThisRecord.Qty})); OrderConfirmationFlow.Run(varNewOrder.'Order Number'); Notify("Order " & varNewOrder.'Order Number' & " submitted.", NotificationType.Success); Navigate(scrMyOrders, ScreenTransition.Fade)
key_formulas.inventory_low_stock_fill: If(ThisItem.'Quantity In Stock' < ThisItem.'Reorder Threshold', RGBA(255,235,235,1), RGBA(255,255,255,1))
key_formulas.status_badge_color: Switch(ThisItem.Status, 'Status (Orders)'.Pending, RGBA(255,193,7,1), 'Status (Orders)'.Confirmed, RGBA(13,110,253,1), 'Status (Orders)'.'In Transit', RGBA(253,126,20,1), 'Status (Orders)'.Delivered, RGBA(25,135,84,1), RGBA(108,117,125,1))

role_based_visibility._comment: Maps Power Apps varUserRole values to visible screens. Set varUserRole in App.OnStart from a Dataverse table or Entra ID group membership.
